comment.body: Thanks for checking the same PDF in Edge. Your confirmation that Edge also shows inches, together with the earlier explanation that Peek uses Edge WebView for PDFs, places the original document-properties unit behavior in the embedded PDF viewer rather than a PowerToys-specific unit conversion. The next useful route for that behavior is Edge/WebView feedback; this does not mean that a PowerToys fix has shipped. The later PDF-loading latency observation is a separate concern and should be tracked independently rather than treated as evidence about measurement units.
